question: What is Wave City Ghaziabad and why is it called a Hi-Tech Smart City?
answer: Wave City is a 4,500-acre master-planned township located directly on the 14-lane Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24). It is pre-certified Platinum Green by the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC). The smart city is governed by an integrated central Command & Control Center monitoring traffic management, automated water metering, automated street lighting, underground fiber optics, and dedicated power substations with underground distribution.

question: Does PropertyKraft charge any brokerage on new booking projects?
answer: No. PropertyKraft is an authorized, RERA-registered Tier-1 channel partner for Wave City and leading developers on NH-24. For all fresh/original builder bookings (such as Veridia, Eligo, Dream Homes, and Developer Plots), our comprehensive advisory, guided site visits, negotiation, and paperwork support are 100% free of brokerage to the buyer.

question: Are residential plots in Wave City freehold and eligible for bank loans?
answer: Yes, all residential and commercial plots allotted in Wave City are clear-title freehold properties. Major nationalized and private banks including State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Punjab National Bank (PNB) offer plot purchase and construction loan facilities up to 75-80% of property value.

question: How fast can I travel to Delhi and Central Noida from Wave City?
answer: Thanks to the 14-lane signal-free Delhi-Meerut Expressway (DME), driving to Akshardham Temple / East Delhi takes approximately 20 to 25 minutes. Central Noida (Sector 62, Sector 63 IT Hub, and Electronic City Metro Station) is reachable within 12 to 15 minutes.

question: Can I arrange a private site visit with pickup?
answer: Absolutely. PropertyKraft offers VIP guided site visits every day of the week between 9:30 AM and 7:00 PM. We provide doorstep pickup from nearby Metro hubs (Noida Sector 62 / Vaishali / Anand Vihar) or meet you at our Wave Galleria head office (SF-102), followed by a golf-cart tour of all live sectors, parks, clubhouses, and sample flats.
